name: ninvaders
why: A terminal Space Invaders clone; a faithful classic, though it is a familiar game rather than a strange one.

brief.what_it_is: nInvaders is a Space Invaders clone that runs in a text terminal using ncurses, so it draws with ASCII characters rather than in a GUI window. The player controls a ship at the bottom of the screen, shoots waves of aliens, and gets bonus points for shooting a UFO. Input is keyboard, and output is the terminal screen. The homepage describes it as a way to play Space Invaders when no GUI is available. Per the SourceForge page it is written in C and licensed under GPLv2.
brief.why_it_exists: The homepage opens with "Ever wanted to play space invaders when you can't find a GUI?" and answers "Now you can!" The stated aim is a playable oldschool Space Invaders for terminal-only setups, with the authors asking for beta testers to help improve it.
brief.how_it_works: The homepage gives no technical detail beyond saying it is based on ncurses. Version 0.1.1 added a timer so the game runs on more platforms (IRIX, Windows, some Red Hat versions), and a title screen.
brief.install_notes: The homepage gives no build or install steps. It points to the SourceForge summary page for the latest release, and to a CVS repository for the working snapshot, which needs a login to the sf.net CVS server. The SourceForge page lists English and German as languages and ncurses as the user interface. Nothing I read mentions hardware, accounts, or runtimes for the game itself, though ncurses is needed to build it.
brief.standout: It is a faithful, minimal terminal take on a classic arcade game, aimed at machines where you only have a shell. The project is old and the game itself is familiar rather than strange, so the appeal is mostly nostalgia and the terminal constraint.
brief.status: Beta on the SourceForge page (project status field), with the last update shown as 2013-04-11. The newest news item on the homepage is dated 08.05.2003 (version 0.1.1), and the project was registered in 2003. The project appears quiet: no release after 0.1.1 is mentioned on the homepage, and I found no recent activity beyond the SourceForge update date.
brief.caveats: The homepage is dated and the news stops at 2003. SourceForge calls the project Beta. The game runs on ncurses, so it is limited to terminals and ASCII output. The 0.1.1 news says the timer was added so the game would run on more platforms, which suggests earlier portability problems. The SourceForge reviews are sparse (three ratings, all five stars), and one reviewer calls the start difficult. The homepage says the download is on SourceForge and gives no install instructions. The homepage also says the project is looking for beta testers.
quotes: Ever wanted to play space invaders when you can't find a GUI?
There's still much to do, so we need *YOU* as beta tester!
